'''Sinya Deboora''' was the [[Magister of Trade]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seltos]], and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. She was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Marse Deboora]], and was in league with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[B. Hensworth]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] in an effort to return Seltos to Imperial control. A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operation, [[Freedom Strike Seltos]], was aimed at proving that she was a spy.
